spec.claim_summary: A drop below Bitcoin's 200-week moving average is presented as a buying opportunity to hold.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: Asset is BTCUSDT because the claim is about Bitcoin.
Timeframe is 1d from the page chart; the claim itself names no bar length.
200-week moving average is mapped to a 1400-period SMA on daily bars (200*7) because the schema allows only 1h/4h/1d with no weekly timeframe; SMA assumed as the default meaning of 'moving average'.
Entry uses crosses_below to encode 'falls below' / 'drops below' as the breakdown event rather than simply being below.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim describes buying below the average and holding to the present with no exit rule; the schema requires an exit so indefinite hold is approximated with a very long max_hold_bars as the closest testable core.

evidence.quote: price falls below its 200-week moving average
Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today
